name: Table Tennis Ball (40 mm)
summary: White matte ABS sphere with a faint equatorial join: smoothly recessed by at most 0.03 mm. A very subtle baked surface normal gives matte plastic texture. No text, stars, logos or stamps.
description: White matte ABS sphere with a faint equatorial join: smoothly recessed by at most 0.03 mm. A very subtle baked surface normal gives matte plastic texture. No text, stars, logos or stamps. Static visual asset; no physics.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python surface meshes and capped seam/thread tubes; Cycles-baked procedural tangent-space normal map. No external assets or markings.

display.origin: Actual floor contact point under the horizontally centred exported bounds

accuracy_notes: ITTF Statutes 2026, Laws of Table Tennis 2.3.1: spherical ball, diameter 40 mm. Fixed nominal size, so no range midpoint applies. The ball is an opaque outer shell; wall thickness, mass, bounce and interior are not modeled. The two molded hemispheres are represented by one continuous sphere with a shallow join. The groove is deliberately subtle. Measured extents include raised seams/threads; nominal diameter describes the skin. Fine grain is normal detail only. Source: https://documents.ittf.sport/sites/default/files/public/2026-02/2026_Statutes_v1_consolidated_clean.pdf
